A national EdTech platform (2M learners): a Education & Research program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; institutional renewals wobbled.
Content production bottlenecked; localization slow. SOC 2 evidence assembled manually per audit.

Learning-gain pipelines (assessment → causal evidence with confounder care) now publish outcome reports per cohort; the content factory produces curriculum variants with editorial QC; and compliance automation turned SOC 2 audits into evidence sampling, procurement gates unblocked.
